title: Weekly Appointment Count for Insured Portal Bookings by Age of the Appointment Series
content:
Decision table — the number of standing appointments per week that an insured portal booking on an Appointment Series counts for each whole week of its window (the insured portal weekly count).

**Rule.** The insured portal weekly count is the format's minimum standing appointments per week where the series started 35 or more calendar days before the booking date, the series' standing appointments per week less one but never below the format's minimum where it started at least 21 but fewer than 35 calendar days before, and the series' standing appointments per week where it started fewer than 21 calendar days before.

**Records read.** The series start date and the standing appointments per week, from the series record.

| Calendar days from the series start date to the booking date | Insured portal weekly count |
|---|---|
| 35 or more | the format's minimum per week |
| 21 to 34 | standing appointments per week less one, never below the format's minimum |
| 0 to 20 | standing appointments per week |

| Visit format | Minimum standing appointments per week |
|---|---|
| Telehealth 30-Minute Visit Series | 1 |
| Standard 45-Minute Visit Series | 1 |
| Extended 60-Minute Visit Series | 1 |
| Aquatic Therapy Visit Series | 1 |
| Specialty One-on-One Visit Series | 1 |
| Post-Operative Priority Visit Series | 2 |

**Boundary rows.** 35 days falls in the first row and 34 in the second; 21 days falls in the second row and 20 in the third.

**Cases (hypothetical).** A Post-Operative Priority Visit Series at 3 a week that started 25 days before the booking date counts 2 a week (3 less one, not below 2). A Standard 45-Minute Visit Series at 1 a week that started 25 days before counts 1 (1 less one is 0, raised to the minimum of 1). The same Post-Operative series started 40 days before counts 2.
